'''Benjamin Steines''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Rochester tournament]] on 4 November 2000 with Hoth guys, walkers, and stuff, according to Tyler Williams's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1425">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-rochester-mn-11-4-00d1425/ rochester-mn-11-4-00], DeckTech (Tyler "rugman11" Williams, 6 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-rochester-mn-11-4-00d1425/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
